pr_title: fix AnimationBlendTree graph update on input count change
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/45437

Connects blend tree plugin to the `tree_changed` signal which is emited when set_input is updated. The signal then calls update_graph.

issue_context.title: Animation Transition node wont update until conected.
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
Godot 3.3

**OS/device including version:**
MX Linux

**Issue description:**
Updating the inputs for the Transition Node wont reflect any change until reconected

**Steps to reproduce:**
Create a Animation Tree
Add AnimationNodeBlendTree as the RootNode
Add Transition Node
Add inputs
You wont see any updates in the node until reconected to something



![AnimTree](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1168582/120944816-d448ae00-c70c-11eb-8d4f-6e56a676c0ee.gif)


**Minimal reproduction project:**
New project is fine
comments:
I think this can be fixed writing a signal, am I wrong? what about `emit_changed` or `emit_signal` on that `AnimationNodeTransition`? I'll do a couple of tests and see if this work.

Edit: After some tests I think properties are not being updated, or the graph is not being updated. Any thoughts?
Edit2: Am I wrong if I assume theres only 1 directionality from graph to properties, but not from properties to graph in any of the Graph Editors? For example, if I write a VisualShader with a TextureUniform, if I add the texture there's no preview in the graph. So I guess there isn't a simple fix?
Edit3: I see Resource is independant from GraphEdit and makes sense to not to trigger any update, but it should have some mechanism to do so. it seems `emit_changed` is not contemplated by GraphEdit update for some reason

Duplicate of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/45437
I would like to implement the fix, or at least try to. I was working on the old issue. I proposed an idea in the chat that was basically.
add a new signal in animation_blend_tree.cpp that is emited by all property methods that update the graph visually. Then have the blend tree plugin connected to that signal and call _update_graph() when it is emited.

@unsignedFoo You would probably make a way better fix though. So if you think my solution is inadequate I would be fine with you doing it.  

As for your comments, yes there is only 1 directionality from graph to properties if I understand correctly. When you update the inspector the input count does update because if you save and close the editor it will refresh the graph properly. The main disconnect is that when properties that edit the graph visually are not triggering the `_update_graph` method. As far as I can see. Although I am not quite sure why dragging the node doesnt update the input count even though it calls `_update_graph` but it does work when you undo a node drag. That might be a different bug entirely.
@kodiwills I managed in some way connecting a signal and emiting the signal but it works randomly. Not sure why. I would like to see your implementation.

The actual solution should probably have its own signal. Then in every property method that changes the graph just emit the signal. I am just really bad with adding signals in code right now since I am so new. I tried to add a signal myself and it broke lol.
